nuggets.text: Alberto Mendoza is the younger brother of Heisman winner Fernando Mendoza and transferred to the Yellow Jackets from Indiana.
Bobby Dodd Stadium opened in 1913 and is the oldest stadium in the FBS; Tech students built most of its first grandstands.
Bobby Dodd Stadium has been the site of more home wins than any other FBS stadium.
The Yellow Jackets beat Cumberland 222-0 in 1916, the most one-sided score in college football history.
The Yellow Jackets won the 1929 Rose Bowl 8-7 after Cal's Roy Riegels ran 65 yards the wrong way.
The Ramblin' Wreck, a 1930 Ford Model A, has led the Yellow Jackets into Bobby Dodd Stadium since 1961.
Bobby Dodd, the Yellow Jackets' legendary coach and stadium namesake, played quarterback at Tennessee from 1928 to 1930.
Saturday marks 40 years since the Vols last played at Grant Field, a 14-13 Yellow Jackets win in 1986.
Brent Key started four years at guard for the Yellow Jackets and was a team captain as a senior in 2000.
Rahkeem Smith's 100-yard kickoff return touchdown against Colorado was only the fifth in Yellow Jackets history.
